description: A wooden jetty on a turquoise bay at golden hour, with a white sailing boat moored beside it and pine trees on the rocky shore. A laughing young woman with long sandy hair in a navy one-piece swimsuit walks barefoot towards the camera and pulls one strap down off her shoulder, showing a pale stripe where the sun has tanned the skin around it. She laughs, covers her face with her hand and swings a white linen shirt. Rope and a canvas bag lie on the boards, and a friend sits at the end.
